title: わけがない、わけはない
meaning: There is no reason (as to) why 〜; It is impossible (for) 〜; cannot
meaning_example: There's no reason why you can't do such an easy job.

sections.body_text:
There is no reason (as to) why 〜; It is impossible (for) 〜; cannot 
 There's no reason why you can't do such an easy job.

comments.text: This pattern is generally used with noun and any form of verb.

comments.text:
＊This grammar is meant to express strong negative judgement.

FORMATION:
Ｖ(plain form) + わけがない
いＡ + わけがない
なＡ + わけがない
Ｎ + の・である + わけがない
